item.name: List coding evaluations based on filter criteria

request.name: List coding evaluations based on filter criteria

response.name: List of coding evaluations. The structure of the returned coding evaluations depends on the 'verbose', 'includeDisplayInfo', 'includePeople', and 'includeQuestionIds' flags in the request. If 'verbose' is true, full coding evaluation details are returned (Coding Evaluation schema). If 'verbose' is false, a reduced coding evaluation object is returned (CodingEvaluationInfo schema). If 'includeDisplayInfo' and 'includePeople' are true, the returned audits will include display info and people respectively. If 'includeQuestionIds' is true, the returned additional criteria responses will include question ids. Both 'verbose' and the other flags can be used together.
